name: millbrook
units: metres; 1 block = 1 m; Godot axes: x east, y up, z south; yaw = Godot rotation.y in degrees

voxels.order: x fastest, then z, then y: index = x + sx * (z + sz * y)

markers.note: outside the mausoleum door, facing out toward the village

areas.name: Stream
areas.note: narrow: test the stream cells, not just the rect

water.note: cells are [x, y, z, flow_x, flow_z, waterfall]; flow is a unit vector in the x-z plane (Godot axes); the stream runs north to south and falls off the south rim into the void. Spirits cannot cross it (running water rule); the plank bridge is the crossing.

night.desc: Play time: deep blue sky, huge soft moon, warm orange windows, low violet mist.

dusk.desc: Lavender and peach sky, long blue shadows, the first candles lit.

dawn.desc: Transition only: pale pink east, candles going out, the living world waking.

day.desc: Living world bleeds through: pale, washed-out, slightly overexposed and hazy; daylight drains the ghost.

fading.desc: Low Remembrance: colours drained toward grey, edges crumbling into floating cubes, a starless void.

cycle.note: Inverted day: night is the ghost's working time, so it gets half the cycle. t in [0, 1); Godot blends the two presets around t. hour is the nominal clock shown on the HUD moon clock.

map.axes: image x -> world +x (east), image y -> world +z (south)
map.note: Orthographic top-down plan of the whole world rect; base for the painted in-game map.
